archive.summary: US firms started taking card payments in person on a card reader, a new banner let firms mark jobs stuck in the last stage complete in one click, Jobs and Tasks began remembering filters, and the Billing Monitor dashboard entered Beta — alongside 9 bug fixes including QES signature requests clients couldn't sign and Desktop edits from Acrobat or Excel not reaching the web.

Tax Return Delivery's new layout graduated out of Beta, the Activity feed started tracking time entries, services and custom rates, automations got a Go to template button, and Inbox+ links began always opening in a new tab — alongside 9 bug fixes including New email accidentally addressing every client and some clients being unable to sign their tax return.

Tax Return Delivery let firms choose when clients pay and each Stripe payout began syncing to QuickBooks as one deposit, Affirm and Klarna pay-over-time and a clearer TRD layout entered Beta, and four TRD AI features started rolling out gradually — alongside 8 bug fixes including images vanishing from job descriptions and mixed-up signer names.

Employee cost rates arrived and Tax Return Delivery's client approval step graduated to full release, plus print/download for draft proposals, Recurring invoices filters, automatic job due-date updates, and Desktop stay-signed-in and auto-launch options — alongside 8 bug fixes including a TRD 404 on creation and signed scanned documents rendering blank.

A big N-Checklists rollout hit Beta — reusable checklist templates, a dedicated Checklists tab supporting more than one checklist per client, roll-forward and bulk-import options, and Jobs page grouping by pipeline or stage — alongside blocking outdated Desktop app versions from signing in and 7 bug fixes including a kiosk-only signer bypass and an autopay proposal that could be signed with no payment method attached.

Firms could agree to and pay a recurring invoice on a client's behalf, Inbox+ got folder-style navigation with a dedicated Mentions folder, and invoices gained bulk print/download plus a gradually-rolling-out in-person card reader — alongside TRD's client approval step and AI review/conflict-handling entering Beta, and 8 bug fixes including a recurring-invoice double-charge on signing day and firm members being able to edit another employee's signer details.

Desktop's new Configure & Send bundled link/lock/approval/signature into one pass, TRD AI graduated into Beta for automatic page grouping and Tax Summary auto-fill, and the Coming Soon board added a Billing Monitor dashboard and BNPL payments — alongside 8 bug fixes including a recurring-invoice double-charge on signing day and signed documents appearing blank in Adobe Acrobat.

Password confirmation is now required before setting up 2FA on the web, Tax Return Delivery graduated out of Beta (with four AI ‘Coming soon’ teasers appearing in its place), and the Coming Soon board launched with seven upcoming TRD, payments, and QuickBooks items — alongside 12 bug fixes including a broken Print-to-TaxDome after a Windows update and a job stage that could silently revert.

The client Overview page got a three-part redesign, clients gained Apple Pay and Google Pay checkout, invoices can now be saved as drafts, and a new Payout Reconciliation Report shipped — alongside 6 new billing features and 7 bug fixes including two Tax Return Delivery approval bugs and a migration tool that silently dropped .zip files.

Pipeline sorting got more useful fields including Intake Date, email threads gained a read/unread filter, and Inbox+ notification cleanup entered beta — alongside 7 bug fixes including recurring invoices marking themselves "Completed" too early and $0 invoices finally payable from the mobile app.

Kiosk Mode let clients fill out organizers right on an office tablet, and firms got a heads-up email ahead of monthly/seasonal seat renewals — alongside 8 bug fixes including a closed QuickBooks security gap, invoices that were getting stuck before reaching QuickBooks, and a payment-method deletion warning for linked recurring invoices.

Payment method restrictions, scheduled bulk client-chat messages, and the redesigned CRM import all reached full release, Work Forecaster job-health indicators entered beta, and the Desktop app started warning about printer setup problems — alongside 8 bug fixes including Klarna/Affirm display issues and job date filters using the wrong timezone.

Automatic pricing-update emails rolled out for special-rate firms, jobs could be assigned by role instead of by name, drag-and-drop returned to the Desktop app's Upload Window, and Payment Method Restrictions entered beta — alongside 8 bug fixes including a 2FA login crash and payment methods getting wiped mid-billing.

Firms got the ability to charge clients' saved payment methods directly, plus beta features for scheduling bulk client-chat messages and smoother CRM imports, alongside 23 bug fixes including a Stripe reconciliation issue and documents stuck in "Sending."
